inclusions.text: Meet at Cairo International Airport and transfer to your hotel
inclusions.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and transferred to your hotel.
A final breakfast on the eighth morning, then the transfer to Cairo International Airport for the onward flight.

inclusions.text: Private departure for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private departure — operated for your party alone, never a shared group.

Your Egyptologist handles Giza, the Memphis-Saqqara-Dahshur sequence, the Bahariya archaeology and the Grand Egyptian Museum; the 4×4 desert drivers handle the off-road country between Bahariya, the Black Desert, the White Desert and the chalk formations.
The night is spent at a desert campsite under open sky — one of the irreplaceable experiences the Western Desert offers, and one that requires no embellishment.
The day ends with a dinner cruise on the Nile — the lit city from the water, at the close of the last full day.
